log.msg: Baseline on current dev (4x, 390px, 3 runs): first bubble painted 8.0 / 8.2 / 8.8 s after tap (207 bubbles). Harnesses copied to ux/Dictate/test/load.mjs and freeze.mjs (repo path fixed, output to OUT_DIR). Plan: coalesce anchor() per frame, defer refresh() for history lines, on_level per frame, cap sheet history to newest 50 via Session.watch on_history, Session.watch byte-range tail. SSE (Sessions.js:605) pushes every written line but drops while the 30 s proxy cut reconnects, so the poll stays as a cheap tail read, not removed.
